findings.motion: Questioning of Deputy Secretary of State Jerry Bonnet at the State Budget Committee about the citizenship-verification list of 585,774 voter names
findings.note: As reported by the Indiana Citizen (not his own quoted words), he asked whether the list held registered voters who may not be citizens. He pointed out that people on the list who voted in 2024 would have had to show a REAL ID driver's license at the polls. He asked whether the office had cross-checked the list against poll books. He also asked whether the office would keep verifying voters' citizenship in the new year.
